title: O Morning Star, Lead Me Forth (Ko Mangkara Ialam Ia Nga)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Ban pruid ki dak sah jingkynmaw,
Jingmut barieh ba ngan pynpaw;
Ha lynti bakhuid jingshisha,
Ko Mangkara ialam ia nga.

Jar jar ha jingdum jong ka miet,
Shaphi bunsien nga ju iai khmied;
Mynsiem jongnga ka sngew tympang,
Jingshai jongphi nga khiaw kyntang.
lyrics_english:
To inscribe marks of eternal memory,
To reveal the secret meditations of the heart;
Along the pure path of truth and light,
O radiant Morning Star, lead Thou me on.

In the serene silence of the night,
Toward Thee my eyes repeatedly gaze upward;
My lonely spirit feels comforted,
Receiving sacred reverence from Thy light.
